The reporting verb is said i.e. in past, therefore, the tense in reported speech must be changed according to past. So ‘Present Indefinite’ tense should be changed into ‘Past Indefinite tense. After ‘when’ use assertive structure of the sentence. Changes to be made in personal pronouns i.e. ‘you’ changes into ‘she’. Change ‘said to’ into ‘enquired’ as the sentence is interrogative.

"
